title: Practice: coordinates on a line segment
intro: Eight questions. Where two boxes are shown, type the $x$-coordinate in the first and the $y$-coordinate in the second.

questions.prompt: Find the midpoint of A$(2, 1)$ and B$(8, 10)$.
Find the point one step at a time.
questions.scenario: A is $(3, 1)$ and B is $(6, 16)$. Find the point $\frac{1}{3}$ of the way along AB from A.

steps.prompt: Horizontal distance from A to B:
Vertical distance from A to B:

questions.explanation: A third of 3 is 1 and a third of 15 is 5, so the point is $(3 + 1, 1 + 5) = (4, 6)$.

questions.prompt: A is $(3, 1)$ and B is $(11, 17)$. Find the point $\frac{1}{4}$ of the way along BA **from B**.
hints: From B you move towards A: left and down.
questions.explanation: A quarter of 8 is 2 and a quarter of 16 is 4. $(11 - 2, 17 - 4) = (9, 13)$.

questions.prompt: C is $(-5, 15)$ and D is $(8, 7)$. Find the point $\frac{1}{4}$ of the way along CD from C.
F is $(-4, -2)$ and E is $(2, 7)$. Find the point $\frac{2}{3}$ of the way along EF **from E**.
hints: From E to F: across $-6$, down $-9$.

questions.prompt: G is $(-4, 14)$ and H is $(6, -1)$. Find the point $\frac{3}{5}$ of the way along GH from G.
P is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the way along AB from A. Which is true?

options.text: P is closer to A than to B
P is closer to B than to A
P is $\frac{1}{3}$ of the way from B

hints: It is $\frac{1}{3}$ from A and $\frac{2}{3}$ from B.
questions.explanation: P is a third of the way from A, so two-thirds of the way from B — closer to A.

questions.prompt: A is $(2, 1)$ and B is $(20, -14)$. Find the point $\frac{1}{3}$ of the way along AB from A.
